TZA.note: Services accept the NIDA number, but no online check is described.

facts.fact: Home Affairs Minister Patrobas Katambi credited NIDA with registering 943,284 Tanzanians, about 1.3% of the 70.5 million population (share calculated here from the population held), with 6,308 printed Zanzibar cards uncollected.

TZA.note: NIDA is said to notify citizens by text message, but who builds and maintains the system is not stated.
Services accepting the NIDA number are not named as registers.

facts.fact: Home Affairs Minister Patrobas Katambi said NIDA has registered 943,284 Tanzanians, that identity cards have been printed (6,308 uncollected in Zanzibar) and that NIDA numbers are accepted for some services.
